{{Quote|Most serious is our presence here. Reports we have received of an infant on Corulag. Told we are, she is strong with the Force.''"<br />"''If the reports are true, it is our duty to bring her to the Temple on Coruscant.|Yoda and Mace Windu|<ref name="EIA4" />}}
'''Teela Panjarra''', a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], was an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the time of the [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Teela Panjarra was born on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] to scholars of the planet's [[Corulag Academy|academy]] before the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invasion of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. When she was six months old her Force-sensitivity was discovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and tagged for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. However, before she could be transported to the [[Jedi academy|academy]], the [[Corulag Academy]]'s Science Services' Chief Scientist [[Frexton]] kidnapped her, wishing to use her to scientifically study [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="EIA4" />

Discovering that the girl had been abducted, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched Jedi [[Vel Ardox]], [[Noro Zak]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to rescue her. As the Jedi were stationed at the Order's [[Jedi chapter house (Rhinnal)|chapter house]] on [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]], they were able to arrive at Corulag quickly, but were soon foiled by [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. Master Jinn and his fellow team members held off the assassins while [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] Yoda himself rescued Panjarra from Chief Frexton and destroyed the Bartokk and their [[Bartokk Queen|queen]]. With the girl safe, the Jedi were able to take Panjarra to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Coruscant Temple]] where she would begin her training.<ref name="EIA4" />
